pages.text: If you're a nerd like the author of this mod, maybe you care about the rate your hives produce comb.$(br2)A full busy hive (5 bees of one kind) makes about $(l)210$() trips per hour of work.$(br2)Away from home it makes about 123; boosted (home biome or the queen) about 244.

Combs per hive-hour = trips x the chance a trip brings that comb home.$(br2)A day is 20 real minutes: about 10.9 of day and 9.1 of night. Overworld bees only work in the day, so a real hour holds about 55% of a hive-hour.
